==Description==
The '''Werewolf''' was a fast enemy that appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It was one of the fastest enemies that appeared in the second act, while also having a high amount of health and a small amount of defense, making it quite dangerous. It also had [[Stun Immunity]], which made the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] slow down the '''Werewolf''' instead of fully stopping it.

==Appearance==
The '''Werewolf''' was a large, humanoid wolf with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It had dark brown fur on its body as well as light grey belly fur. It had a tail, three long pale yellow claws at the ends of its arms, four short pale yellow claws on its feet, a muzzle with teeth, ears with white fur, glowing blue eyes and a bushy tail. It left a trail of wind particles as it ran.

The '''Werewolf''' had a death animation where it would kneel while making a howling sound.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against the '''Werewolf'''.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively.
*As this enemy is quite fast, slowing towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Warden]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against it.
**Do note that as the '''Werewolf''' is a large enemy, making freezing towers and the [[Warden]] slow it down for a shorter amount of time.
**The '''Werewolf''' also has the [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that it cannot be completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]], only being slowed down.
**Some of the slowing towers, like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Freezer]] can also decrease defense, though since it has a pretty low defense, this is not necessary.
